s: squash (drink made from syrup and water)
Sirup.et: From Middle High German sirup, sirop (13th c.), from Medieval Latin siruppus, siropus, from Arabic شَرَاب (šarāb, “drink”). See English syrup for more.

Sirene.et: In the mythological sense from Middle High German sirēne, from Latin Sirēn, in the acoustical sense from French sirène, in the botanical sense confused from Syringe from Latin sȳrinx which was before the introduction of the lilac to Europe in the 16th century …
